card.fires_on: The middle piece of a unit written in parts, such as the W in mW/cm2, the ol in mmol/L, or the g in mcg/mL. It fires just before the slash and the per-volume or per-area part.

modes.label: Power and flux units
modes.description: The W of watt units such as mW/cm2 or W/m2 in irradiance and radiation text.

modes.label: Molar and mass concentration units
modes.description: The ol of mmol or mcmol, or the g of mcg, mg, before /L or /mL.
